# Pediatrics — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the role of Pediatrics?", "child health"),
    ("What category is Pediatrics?", "children"),
    ("What is category?", "children"),
    ("What is role?", "child health"),
    ("What is sources/training?", "3 years residency"),
    ("What is note?", "From birth to adolescence"),
]

for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
